verdict.rationale: Undermind's docs explicitly claim inline citations traceable back to source papers ('Trace any statement by following in-line citations back to the source paper', citations linking back to source papers in notes/synthesis), and community feedback corroborates that it addresses the citation-avoidance problem of raw LLMs ('Claude 3.5 is reluctant to provide references... Undermind solves this particular problem'). Missing for 10: independent verification of citation accuracy/completeness at the claim level, and no evidence addressing edge cases where synthesis claims might lack a direct citation.
